weekly_now.title: This week's pick and amount
weekly_now.description: The main index pick, the weekly EUR 40-200 buy amount and the signal meter, decided at the Friday close. Yahoo Finance ETF prices, Federal Reserve (FRED) stress gauges.

weekly_history.title: Weekly history
weekly_history.description: Every week since Jan 2012: the main index pick, the MSCI World ETF close, the rule amount, the meter and each index's 52-week return.

meter_now.title: Market meter
meter_now.description: The −100…+100 market meter and its six components (MSCI World trend and discount, VIX, NFCI, Sahm, yield curve). Descriptive only.

demo_positions.title: Demo: holdings
demo_positions.description: The demo account's current holdings: 70% main-index ETF, 30% in its 3 strongest stocks, valued in euros.

demo_ledger.title: Demo: trades
demo_ledger.description: Every buy and sell of the EUR 1,000 demo account, with costs and profit/loss.

indicators.title: Market gauges
indicators.description: Nine US stress and rate readings from the Federal Reserve (VIX, yield curve, Sahm rule, credit spread, NFCI, Fed funds, 10Y yield, CPI, unemployment).

weekly_tiers.title: Weekly amount rule
weekly_tiers.description: The five weekly amount tiers, measured on the MSCI World ETF.

plans_summary.title: Return plans
plans_summary.description: The 10/20/30% leveraged plans tested on US data 1990–2026 (research only).

plans_growth.title: Plan growth since 1990
plans_growth.description: Growth of the three research plans since 1990, monthly.

plans_years.title: Plan returns by year
plans_years.description: Calendar-year returns of the three research plans.

hist_plans.title: Plans over 100 years
hist_plans.description: The 10/20/30% plans simulated 1927–2026 on Kenneth French US market total returns (monthly), with daily-reset drag, fees and cash at the T-bill rate.

hist_plans_growth.title: Plan growth since 1927
hist_plans_growth.description: Value of 1 unit invested in Jan 1927, at each year end.

hist_weekly_rule.title: Weekly rule over 100 years
hist_weekly_rule.description: Money-weighted yearly return of the EUR 40-200 drawdown tiers vs a flat amount, US market total returns (French).

hist_factors.title: Value and momentum since 1927
hist_factors.description: Long/short factor returns 1927–2026 (Kenneth French data library), premium over cash, before costs.

hist_factor_growth.title: Factor growth since 1927
hist_factor_growth.description: Value of 1 unit in each long/short factor, year-end.

hist_decades.title: Returns by decade
hist_decades.description: Yearly returns by decade 1927–2026: US market, 20%/30% plans, value, momentum, their mix and cash.

markets.title: Markets today
markets.description: Major indexes, currencies and commodities from the Federal Reserve (FRED), updated every weekday.

regions.title: World stock markets since 1990
regions.description: Total returns in US dollars by region, Jul 1990 to the latest month (Kenneth French data library).

regions_years.title: World markets by year
regions_years.description: Calendar-year total returns by region in US dollars.

index_rank.title: This week's index ranking
index_rank.description: Six euro-listed index ETFs scored by return per unit of risk (52-week return ÷ volatility), with the main index pick (0.25 buffer).

pick_rank.title: Stocks of the picked index
pick_rank.description: Every stock in the picked index's universe, ranked; top = buy candidates, bottom = avoid/short candidates.

ip_backtest.title: Index pick backtest
ip_backtest.description: Lump-sum test 2012 to today on real ETF prices in euros: the pick vs holding each index.

ip_buying.title: Weekly buying backtest
ip_buying.description: Money-weighted return of buying weekly (EUR 40-200 rule) into the World ETF, the S&P 500 ETF or the weekly pick, 2012 to today.

ip_growth.title: Index pick growth
ip_growth.description: Value of 1 euro invested in January 2012: the pick vs World, S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, Europe and equal weight.

ip_years.title: Index pick by year
ip_years.description: Calendar-year returns of the pick and each index ETF, in euros.

ip_periods.title: Pick history
ip_periods.description: Every stretch the pick held one index since 2012, with its return and the World ETF's over the same weeks.

news_feed.title: Headlines
news_feed.description: Latest headlines from the Fed, ECB, Bank of Japan, CNBC, MarketWatch and Google News on the picked index and stocks (titles and links only).

hist_rotation.title: Index pick on 35 years of regional data
hist_rotation.description: Monthly test of the index pick across North America, Europe, Japan, Asia Pacific ex-Japan and emerging markets (US dollars, Kenneth French data library).

hist_rotation_decades.title: Index pick by decade
hist_rotation_decades.description: Yearly return by decade of the index pick, the previous rule, the developed world and North America.

extra_positions.title: Extra profit: this week's picks
extra_positions.description: The weekly 3 longs and 3 shorts of the main index, with weights (% of your money on each side, inverse volatility).

extra_ledger.title: Extra profit: closed picks
extra_ledger.description: Every closed weekly pick with its return and profit/loss.

demo_value.title: Demo account value
demo_value.description: The demo account's value each Friday close, the money deposited (EUR 1,000 a week) and the same deposits in the MSCI World ETF.

hist_overlay.title: Momentum stocks since 1927
hist_overlay.description: Yearly return and worst fall of the US market, the demo account mix (70% market + 30% top-decile momentum stocks), all-momentum and a long/short version, by period (Kenneth French data library, before costs).

meter_test.title: Market meter vs the next year
meter_test.description: Average MSCI World ETF return over the next 4 and 52 weeks for each meter reading, weekly 2012-today.

ip_variants.title: Index-pick variants (ETF)
ip_variants.description: Each rule variant tested weekly 2012-today on the six ETFs in euros, with results for 2012-18 and 2019-today.

hist_rotation_variants.title: Index-pick variants on regional data
hist_rotation_variants.description: Each rule variant tested monthly 1991-today on regional data, with results for 1991-2008 and 2009-today.
